items.authorMeta.name: countryroadssourdough
items.text:
Like so many I started with sourdough, threw it away, shed a few tears (postpartum hormones😅), went down a sourdough rabbit hole, got overwhelmed, almost quit again, took a class, and then produced an edible loaf and was hooked 👏

But with two little boys and a busy lifestyle I needed to find a way to make sourdough work for me (not the other way around). So I started experimenting, skipping steps, speeding up the timeline which eventually led me to the recipe and method I’ve been using and teaching for years 🤗 

And when I realized how many people out there wanted quick & easy same day sourdough recipes I started making more and which eventually led me to creating this book and seeing it in so many of your homes is the best thing ever 🥹

So whether you want the book or are just looking to follow along for quick and easy sourdough recipes for free on my blog (I have over 150!!), welcome ❤️

#samedaysourdough #sourdoughrecipes #sourdough #fromscratch #bakingbread

Recipe 
(for baking pan with dimensions 8.27x4.80x4.53 inch)

280g bread flour
33g sugar

Roll in butter

Laminate with 1 double and 1 single fold, roll into rectangle with sides 8.6x6.7 inches/22x17cm divide into 8 pieces, roll.
Bake at 375F for 22-25 min.

Someone asked me how to make this loaf, so here’s the full tutorial 

Pumpkin dough:
300g flour
195g water
90g pumpkin purée
100g sourdough starter
6g salt
 

Black dough:
150g Blackery flour 
100g water
6g charcoal powder 
55g sourdough starter
3g salt

Mix both doughs, let ferment for 6 hours at 26C then roll the black dough thin, shape pumpkin dough as round, spread thin layer of water on top of black dough, put pumpkin dough inside, wrap black dough around, then place loaf into a banetton, proof overnight in the fridge.
Next day bake at 500F with steam for 15min, and 450F for 20 min without steam.

#halloween #jackskellington #sourdough #bread #recipe

items.authorMeta.name: natashas_baking
items.text:
Everyone is judging the $60 rye bread… but have you actually tried making one? 

I did.

And the entire process took me about 3 days.

Multiple stages of fermentation, carefully controlled temperatures, mixing, shaping, proofing, baking—and then you still have to wait about 24 hours before you can even slice it.

My ingredients alone were almost $9 for one loaf.

Now imagine doing this commercially in SoHo, NYC. Add labor, equipment, electricity, packaging, New York rent, and all the other costs of running a bakery. They even bring their grain from Austria.

Do I think $60 is expensive for a loaf of bread? Of course.

But after making it myself, I don’t think it’s fair to look at flour + water + salt and assume the rest is pure profit.

We’re so used to cheap industrial bread that sometimes we forget what goes into making bread slowly, traditionally, and at a very high level.

And maybe the most interesting thing about this $60 loaf isn’t whether you or I would actually pay $60 for it.

It got thousands of people talking about rye bread. About fermentation. About grain. About traditional baking. And about what handmade food is actually worth.

And I think that’s pretty amazing.

So now that you’ve seen the process… do you still think $60 for a loaf of bread is crazy? 

Full recipe and the entire 3-day process are on my website.
#rye #bread #sourdough #recipe

items.authorMeta.name: bunsfromhome
items.text:
EP. 6 come see for yourself 

okay, we know the lead-up to this has been long and a little emotional, but it was important to us that you knew the whole story.

changing the way we do things wasn’t a decision we made on a whim. buns has grown a LOT and we’re incredibly proud of that, but we never want growing to mean compromising on the things that made you love us in the first place.

everything we make is still rolled by hand. megan and the team are still in the kitchen developing, testing, tasting and arguing over what needs a little more of this or a little less of that. and your opinions are still very much part of that process too.

we’re changing because we want to keep doing all of that properly, while giving new buns a little more time to stick around.

so after all this talking, we think it’s about time you actually tried them...

come see us at notting hill on 19 september for first batch. the first 100 of you through the doors from 10am will get your first bun on us. try the new seasonal menu, tell us what you think and help us shape what comes next.

see you soon x
items.musicMeta.musicName: pop! (tapping the mouth with a hand)(912415)

items.authorMeta.name: bunsfromhome
items.text:
EP. 5 we use it all 

we don't usually make a big fuss about this because our waste-not bakes speak for themselves, but it's actually pretty interesting.

with 24 bakeries, we can get our baking schedules pretty damn close but no two days are ever exactly the same. sometimes that means we're left with buns that haven't sold.

luckily, we quite like a challenge.

an unsold bun? add a little something and give it another life. dough offcuts from the lamination station? umm okay, apparently we're making the world's best focaccia.

basically, we're big believers that the first idea doesn't always have to be the last one.

turns out a second life can be pretty bloody good x #bunsfromhomelondon #wastenot #london

items.authorMeta.name: bunsfromhome
items.text:
EP. 4 what makes a classic

okay, we’ve changed a few things but nobody is touching the classics.

we owe the buns that got us where we are today a lot and they’ve very much secured their spots in our core range (yup, cardamom is there, don’t stress x).

but obviously megan wasn’t going to leave the sweet side of the menu there. she’s got a sweet tooth through and through and, having seen what she’s been cooking up, we think you’re going to be pretty happy with what’s joining the classics.

classics stay. new sweets incoming. everybody wins x #seasonal #sweettreat #bunsfromhomelondon

items.authorMeta.name: bunsfromhome
items.text:
EP. 3 for the love of savoury

you love it. we love it. our dough speaks for itself.

not to gas ourselves up but we've kinda nailed the whole sweet bun thing and a new seasonal menu wouldn't be much fun without giving ourselves a bit of a challenge.

megan couldn't contain the ideas after developing the confit garlic and ham + cheese buns. give her an inch and apparently she'll make an entire savoury menu.

each one works with the dough in a completely different way, packed with the kind of flavours that make sense as the weather starts getting a little colder. #savourybreakfast #seasonal #londonhotspots #bunsfromhome

items.authorMeta.name: bunsfromhome
items.text:
EP 2: how the seasons inspire

unsurprisingly, megan doesn't really clock off.

she'll be making dinner with an ingredient she's currently loving and five minutes later she's wondering what would happen if she rolled it into our dough or what she could pair it with.

this means the seasons have a pretty big say in what ends up on our menu. what's good right now, what megan's eating and what she can't stop thinking about all eventually finds its way back to the buns kitchen and then into your hands.

good news for us because autumn has given her A LOT to think about. #newmenu #bunsfromhomelondon #seasonal #inspiration

EP 1: we’re retiring the weekend special

we know we have some explaining to do...

after years of giving you a new bun every single weekend, we’re officially retiring the weekend special.

we know. BIG NEWS.

but before anyone panics, we’re not done making new buns. quite the opposite actually. WE want more time to make bloody good ones and YOU deserve more than three days to actually eat them. seems fair, right?

things are (very excitingly!) changing around here. megan will explain the rest so keep those eyes peeled 👀 #newmenu #weekendspecial #bunsfromhomelondon

items.text:
some buns don’t stay away for long. baklava  has a habit of coming back…mostly because you keep asking for it.

this one is all about contrast. pistachio cream and roasted nuts at the base, a crisp kataifi nest for crunch, more pistachio cream layered generously through the centre, honey syrup for that glossy sweetness, and a final scatter of ground pistachio on top.

it’s nutty and fragrant, sticky in the right way, and unapologetically pistachio-forward.

if you’ve had it before, you already know.
if you haven’t, this is your chance.

After four wonderful years, it is time to say our goodbye, our landlord has increased our rent beyond what makes this special spot viable for us. Having started in my mum's home kitchen, right around the corner from here, my heart is saying 'stay anyway'. Then I remember that thanks to you, we're also on Talbot Road, just off Portobello Road and look forward to welcoming you all there.

Our last day in our second ever home will be this Sunday (8th March 2026), we'll be open until 18:00 and we'd love to see some familiar faces (it's not goodbye) 😢

If you're not able to make it, see you soon at 128 Talbot Road (Just off Portobello Road).

Barney

this one started quietly. a small test bake. seven bakeries. no big launch. just a bun we thought people might like.

turns out, they really did.

our matcha blueberry double baked bun starts with our blueberry muffin bun, baked until soft and golden. filled and topped with a white chocolate matcha ganache truffle, and baked again so everything melts together just right.

the second bake gives it depth and texture. it also means surplus buns don’t go to waste. instead, they become something new.

it’s now heading to all our bakeries from 21st january as a permanent addition to our counters. #matcha #matchadessert #bakery #sweettreat #matchalovers

items.text:
Spooky Gingerbread 👻

🧟‍♀️ 375g Plain flour
🧙‍♀️ 1 tsp bicarbonate of soda
🧟‍♀️ 3.5 Teaspoons ground ginger
🧙‍♀️ 120g unsalted butter
🧟‍♀️ 175g light brown soft sugar
🧙‍♀️ 5 Tablespoons golden syrup
🧟‍♀️ 1 Egg

1. Pop your oven on to 180 fan 
2. Put the flour, bicarb & ginger in a bowl. Give it a quick mix.
3. Add your butter to the bowl which needs to be cubed before adding. Mix this in with your hands like your makimg breadcrumbs. 
4. Add in the sugar and mix, jist until they are combined.
5. Add in your golden syrup & egg. Mix under combined & it makes a dough. 
6. Chuck some flour on your worktop and then roll out your dough. 
7. Roll the dough out to a thickness of 0.5cm or thicker if you would like.
8. Line some oven trays with grease proof paper, I used 4 x trays.
9. Bake for around 10-14 mins depending if you like them soft or harder
10. Decorate however spooky you like, I used @Dr.Oetker Baking Ireland icing pens as they are ao easy to pipe

#gingerbread #bakingrecipe #halloweentreats #gingerbreadman #gingerbreadmen #baking

Make a Spooky Chocolate bar with me 👻

You will need: 

🩸400g white chocolate 
🩸Roughly 100g carnation caramel
🩸 Red food colouring 
🩸 White food colouring optional 

👻 Melt half the white chocolate & add in some white food colouring, add to bar mould (make sure you add to the sides)
👻 pop in the fridge
👻 mix the caramel with red food colouring & add to the middle area only, put in fridge
👻 chop & melt the rest of the white choc, add white food colouring & add to the bar mould
👻 pop in fridge until solid
👻 splatter red food colouring on your chocolate bar & refrigerate

@Carnation 

#chocolatebar #halloweentiktok #chocolatelover #halloweenbaking #chocolaterecipe

Spooky Witch Caldron Mini Cookie Pies 🧙‍♀️

💚 100g Butter
💚 115g Light Brown Sugar
💚 50g Granulated Sugar
💚 1 egg
💚 1 tsp Vanilla
💚 175g Plain Flour
💚 25g Cocoa
💚 10g Dark Cocoa
💚 Half Tsp Salt
💚 Half Tsp Bicarb
💚 100g Milk Choc Chips
💚 @Marks & Spencer Golden Blonde spread

🧙‍♀️ Add the butter & sugars and cream them together. 
🧙‍♀️ Add the egg & vanilla & mix
🧙‍♀️ Add the flour, cocoa’s, salt & bicarb then mix
🧙‍♀️ Once a dough is formed add the choc chips & mix, it will be a thick dough
🧙‍♀️ Line the bottom/sides of your tin with greaseproof paper & add 3-4 of your dough to the bottom of the baking tin
🧙‍♀️ mix your filling with green food colouring & add to insides of cookie pies
🧙‍♀️ Add your cookie pie tops & bake at 180 degrees for around 20 mins 

Decorate 

💚 300g White chocolate 
💚 Green choc food colouring
💚 Mint Aeros @Nestlé 
💚 @CadburyUK Fingers
💚 Googly eyes 

🧙‍♀️Melt the white chocolate & add green food colouring & other choc bits
